# Omni HR | Product Overview

Omni HR is a modular HRIS, local remuneration, hosting remuneration and EOR for multinational teams in Asia. The core of the product is to create a unified workspace around staff, recruitment, pay/leave time or talent management, reducing fragmentation tools and manual maintenance.
